retrievalProfile.description: A painterly mid-century aesthetic featuring a central figure in a suit surrounded by vibrant yellow and orange washes and a minimalist line-art piano.
excludeWhen: dark or moody color palettes are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, smiling male figure in a brown suit walking forward, rendered in a painterly style with visible brushstrokes. The background is a luminous, textured wash of yellow and orange gouache, featuring a faint, pink-outlined grand piano to the left. Bold, blue slab-serif typography spans the upper third, paired with a delicate italicized serif for the artist's name.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure anchored by vibrant yellow-orange background wash
Typographic weight balanced against the visual weight of the suit
Faint line-art piano providing context without competing with the portrait
High-contrast blue text against warm background tones
coreInvariants: Textured, visible brushwork in the portrait
Slab-serif display type in a contrasting cool color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-length central figure, approximately 70% of vertical height, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark shoes and the saturated brown of the suit provide the base anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bold blue title, moves down to the face, follows the suit down to the feet, and circles back to the piano sketch.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space on the left and right edges where the yellow wash fades out.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm Yellow and Orange (background wash and highlights)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Brown and Black (suit and shoes)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cobalt Blue (primary text) and Magenta (piano outline)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the center wash, fading to low saturation at the edges; high value contrast between the suit and the background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or synthetic digital colors
Limit to earth tones, primary yellow, and a single cool accent

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Sturdy slab serif and elegant transitional serif
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses heavy, rectangular slabs with minimal contrast
Subtitle uses high-contrast strokes with sharp, angled serifs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, masculine slab serif paired with a delicate, feminine italic serif for contrast.
graphicDevices: Magenta rectangle in top right corner for secondary branding
Thin line-art illustration of a grand piano

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, uniform slab serif display style
Captures the elegant, high-contrast serif subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a painterly illustration of a man in a brown suit walking forward, set against a textured yellow and orange gouache wash. Include a faint, pink line-drawing of a grand piano to the left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the title in a bold blue slab-serif font across the top, and the artist name in a dark brown italicized serif font below it to the right.

verificationChecks: Is the background wash textured like gouache?
Is the primary text a bold slab serif in blue?
Is the piano rendered as a simple line drawing?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Proprietary logos in the top right corner
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the blue text is legible against the yellow background
Verify the painterly style is consistent across the figure and background
Check that the piano sketch remains a secondary, subtle element
Confirm the slab-serif font has the correct mid-century weight
recipe.reuseFormula: Painterly Portrait + Luminous Gouache Wash + Slab Serif Display Type + Line Art Accent
